structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: The issue explicitly forbids free-form provider authority and requires deterministic versioned events, authenticated scope and independence from external channels.

entries.plausible_wrong_implementation: Permit providerText to invent a notification fact, accept client-selected organization or create through an external channel.
The notification producer would require a connected external push/email adapter or AI provider even to persist an in-app event.
A free-form presentation template would synthesize a currency, severity or amount not present in typed event facts.
Tests of a hard-coded notification UI would pass despite absent persisted preferences, concurrent deduplication or lease recovery.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: The public collection requires deterministic pagination, read/unread persistence and safe navigation for inaccessible sources.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: Event facts are controlled at the internal publisher and serialized to in-app, API and outbox without recomputing money or trusting provider prose.

documentation_consistency.applicability_reason: New docs/FINANCIAL_NOTIFICATIONS.md specifies deterministic event creation, HTTP boundary, defaults and deferred external channels; source documentation outside the diff was searched for conflicting behavior.
new_contract_terms: in-app habilitado e determinístico sem IA
